title: L’Oréal Paris USA announces the 2026 class of Women of Worth honourees
summary: The philanthropic initiative, now in its third decade, sees L’Oréal Paris USA recognise ten female nonprofit leaders and fuel their ventures with grants, mentorships and national visibility

title: What happened to the beauty metaverse? Experts weigh in…
summary: With conversations around the metaverse declining almost as rapidly as they first appeared, Cosmetics Business looks back at the beauty industry’s heavy investment into the virtual concept, while experts explain where it all went wrong

title: Beauty M&A has outperformed the broader consumer market in 2026
summary: Skin care remains the most active beauty subsector for M&A deals in 2026, with buyers increasingly favouring science-backed products focused on skin health and longevity, according to new data from international investment bank DC Advisory

title: Sephora closes stores in France amid riots
summary: After demonstrations in France turned violent, Sephora closed stores to keep staff safe, the LVMH-owned retailer’s President of Europe and Middle East, Catherine Spindler, said

title: From extremophile fermentation to skin resilience: Introducing PromaCare TTF
summary: PromaCare TTF brings extremophile-inspired biotechnology into modern skincare, offering formulators a fermentation-derived ingredient designed for sensitive, stressed and barrier-compromised skin

title: What today's consumers want from skin and sun care
summary: Today's beauty consumers expect more from their skin care and sun care products. Beyond visible results, they want products that feel good on the skin and align with their sustainability priorities. For beauty brands, meeting these expectations presents an opportunity to differentiate in a competitive market

title: Hair mists: the future of dry shampoo
summary: Brands are rethinking what dry shampoo can do, swapping traditional powders for hair mist formats that refresh hair, absorb excess oil and are more scalp conscious, writes Megan Fahy

title: PPWR: Connect Each Pack to its Evidence with Centric PLM
summary: A new bottle, pump or carton change triggers a complex data problem for beauty brands. Each new component requires accurate specifications, supplier documentation and compliance records throughout development
